raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Qwen4Exp QSA: add an sm_120 launch config for the indexer prefill scoring kernel `_qsa_mqa_paged_prefill_kernel`, which uses its GB300 config on every GPU today. It is selected by the existing `_is_sm120` gate of `nvidia/ops/qsa.py`. Bit-equal. Stacked on #65470 (its commit `b07d5d1` is the first of this branch; only the second commit is new). Related: #62344 (sm_80 config for this kernel; the second to merge needs a small rebase in `_prefill_logits`).

## Claims

- On RTX PRO 6000 (sm_120), 8k to 64k context, over mixed steps, equal chunks and single chunks: 1.13x to 5.42x with a BF16 index cache, 1.10x to 3.69x with FP8. Faster than the GB300 config in every cell; bit-equal.
- Other GPUs keep the GB300 values.

## Validation

**Tests** (8 passed on 1 x RTX PRO 6000; 46 with the compact-grid and selection tests): new `tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_indexer_launch_config.py`, added to the `qwen4_exp` CI step, checks the sm_120 config against the default bit for bit (BF16 and FP8; one request, equal chunks, uneven requests, a mixed step), switching by patching `_is_sm120`. The CI step runs on H200 and there is no sm_120 runner, so in CI it guards bit-equality of the two configs compiled for sm_90.

**Config choice:** sweep TILE_R {16, 32, 64} x BLOCK_N {32, 64, 128} x K_TILES {2, 4, 8, 16} x STAGES {1, 2} x num_warps {4, 8}, each on the grid `_prefill_logits` picks. Every config that compiled was bit-equal; 8 BF16 configs (TILE_R=64, BLOCK_N=128, STAGES=2) ran out of shared memory (114,688 bytes needed, 101,376 available). Chosen per cache dtype: the best geomean speedup among configs faster than the default in all 12 cells (56 BF16 and 37 FP8 qualified; geomeans 1.82x and 1.70x). It is within 32% of each cell's own best (largest gaps 32%, 24%, 18%); per-shape keys would add compile variants and fit single measurements. Values (TILE_R, BLOCK_N, K_TILES, STAGES, num_warps): BF16 (16, 64, 4, 1, 4), FP8 (32, 64, 4, 2, 4).

**Kernel benchmark:** 1 x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (driver 580.82.07, CUDA 13.0), torch 2.14.0+cu130, triton 3.8.0, vLLM `3b6eeb06` + compact grid + this PR (the branch is rebased onto `866bccf`; the touched files differ only by the `_topk` condition of #56102). `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next` indexer shapes at TP=1, random tensors. Same process, final tree: the kernel at the GB300 config on the grid `_prefill_logits` picks (before) against `_prefill_logits` (after); CUDA graph of 20 calls, 128 MB L2 flush before each of 5 replays; median of 3 runs (run-to-run spread of a speedup at most 0.9%).

Times in us, GB300 config -> sm_120 config:

| Scenario | Index cache | 8k | 32k | 64k | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| mixed step (2298 rows: 2048 + 100 x 1-4, 101 requests) | BF16 | 96.6 -> 47.1 (2.05x) | 334.3 -> 203.5 (1.64x) | 652.6 -> 402.0 (1.62x) | bit-equal |
| mixed step | FP8 | 38.1 -> 26.8 (1.42x) | 148.1 -> 125.5 (1.18x) | 275.2 -> 249.3 (1.10x) | bit-equal |
| 8 equal chunks (8 x 256) | BF16 | 55.1 -> 23.6 (2.34x) | 109.6 -> 82.7 (1.33x) | 202.0 -> 179.5 (1.13x) | bit-equal |
| 8 equal chunks | FP8 | 27.9 -> 12.6 (2.22x) | 71.3 -> 39.4 (1.81x) | 126.9 -> 110.2 (1.15x) | bit-equal |
| 1 chunk of 512 | BF16 | 54.1 -> 10.0 (5.42x) | 54.8 -> 23.6 (2.32x) | 55.9 -> 41.0 (1.36x) | bit-equal |
| 1 chunk of 512 | FP8 | 27.0 -> 7.3 (3.69x) | 28.6 -> 12.8 (2.23x) | 37.2 -> 21.8 (1.70x) | bit-equal |
| 1 chunk of 2048 | BF16 | 54.9 -> 23.2 (2.36x) | 109.2 -> 77.4 (1.41x) | 200.3 -> 163.9 (1.22x) | bit-equal |
| 1 chunk of 2048 | FP8 | 28.5 -> 12.6 (2.26x) | 70.0 -> 38.6 (1.82x) | 112.6 -> 93.7 (1.20x) | bit-equal |

Script, runner, sweep, raw JSONL and test logs: https://gist.github.com/gzatravkin/0f2c969254be9e05a247aaf6b25bdce3

Not measured: sm_121 (it keeps the GB300 config; the gate is exactly (12, 0)) and end-to-end serving. The RTX PRO 6000 is the GPU of the ARC-AGI-3 Kaggle competition, where our entry served a Qwen4Exp model.

## Details

The launch kwargs move into `_PREFILL_CONFIG` (GB300, unchanged values) and `_SM120_PREFILL_CONFIG`, each keyed by index cache dtype; `_prefill_launch_config(cache_dtype)` picks one and `_prefill_logits` passes it to the launch.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.nvidia.ops import qsa_indexer as qsa_indexer_ops
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import HAS_TRITON, triton
+
+requires_qsa_kernels = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda() or not HAS_TRITON,
+    reason="QSA kernels require CUDA and Triton",
+)
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+PAGE_SIZE = 16
+PAGES = 6
+HEADS = 4
+HEAD_DIM = 32
+# (rows per request, query_offset, num_queries); num_queries=None means all rows.
+LAYOUTS = {
+    "one_request": ((200,), 0, None),
+    "eight_equal_chunks": ((96,) * 8, 0, None),
+    "mixed_step": ((300,) + (1, 2, 3, 4) * 25, 0, None),
+    "zero_row_requests": ((0, 70, 0, 0, 5, 0), 0, None),
+    "request_longer_than_tile": ((130, 3), 0, None),
+    "offset_into_chunk": ((70, 0, 0, 5, 1), 30, 40),
+    "offset_across_requests": ((64, 64), 10, 100),
+    "leading_empty_run": ((0, 0, 33), 0, None),
+    "long_request_last": ((1, 2, 3, 4) * 40 + (300,), 0, None),
+    "window_over_many_requests": ((7,) * 60, 50, 200),
+    "requests_outside_the_window": ((10,) * 20 + (100,) + (10,) * 20, 200, 100),
+}
+CONFIGS = {
+    torch.bfloat16: dict(TILE_R=64, BLOCK_N=64, K_TILES=16, STAGES=2, num_warps=4),
+    torch.float8_e4m3fn: dict(TILE_R=32, BLOCK_N=64, K_TILES=16, STAGES=2, num_warps=8),
+}
+CACHE_DTYPES = [
+    torch.bfloat16,
+    pytest.param(torch.float8_e4m3fn, id="fp8"),
+]
+SENTINEL = -12345.0
+
+
+def _make_batch(
+    rows_per_request: Sequence[int], dtype: torch.dtype, seed: int = 0
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    requests = len(rows_per_request)
+    total = sum(rows_per_request)
+    q = torch.randn((total, HEADS, HEAD_DIM), generator=generator)
+    cache = torch.randn((requests * PAGES, PAGE_SIZE, 1, HEAD_DIM), generator=generator)
+    table = torch.randperm(requests * PAGES, generator=generator).view(requests, PAGES)
+    # Offsets share a non-zero base, as in a slice of a larger backing tensor.
+    starts = torch.tensor([0, *rows_per_request]).cumsum(0) + 3
+    visible = torch.randint(
+        1, PAGES * PAGE_SIZE + 1, (total,), generator=generator, dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    return (
+        q.to(dtype).to(DEVICE),
+        cache.to(dtype).to(DEVICE),
+        table.to(torch.int32).to(DEVICE),
+        starts.to(torch.int32).to(DEVICE),
+        visible.to(DEVICE),
+    )
+
+
+def _launch(
+    batch: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+    query_offset: int,
+    num_queries: int,
+    config: dict[str, int],
+    compact: bool,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    q, cache, table, starts, visible = batch
+    requests = table.shape[0]
+    width = table.shape[1] * cache.shape[1]
+    logits = torch.full((num_queries, width), SENTINEL, device=q.device)
+    tile_r = config["TILE_R"]
+    k_programs = triton.cdiv(width, config["BLOCK_N"] * config["K_TILES"])
+    if compact:
+        grid: tuple[int, ...] = (num_queries // tile_r + requests, 1, k_programs)
+    else:
+        longest = int((starts[1:] - starts[:-1]).max())
+        grid = (requests, triton.cdiv(min(num_queries, longest), tile_r), k_programs)
+    qsa_indexer_ops._qsa_mqa_paged_prefill_kernel[grid](
+        q,
+        cache,
+        table,
+        starts,
+        visible,
+        logits,
+        *q.stride()[:-1],
+        *cache.stride()[:2],
+        *table.stride()[:-1],
+        *logits.stride()[:-1],
+        num_queries,
+        query_offset,
+        table.shape[1],
+        requests,
+        PAGE_SIZE=cache.shape[1],
+        NUM_HEADS=q.shape[1],
+        HEAD_DIM=q.shape[2],
+        COMPACT=compact,
+        STAGES=config["STAGES"],
+        TILE_R=tile_r,
+        BLOCK_N=config["BLOCK_N"],
+        K_TILES=config["K_TILES"],
+        num_warps=config["num_warps"],
+    )
+    return logits
+
+
+def _window(layout: str) -> tuple[Sequence[int], int, int]:
+    rows_per_request, offset, count = LAYOUTS[layout]
+    return rows_per_request, offset, sum(rows_per_request) if count is None else count
+
+
+@requires_qsa_kernels
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cache_dtype", CACHE_DTYPES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", list(LAYOUTS))
+def test_qsa_prefill_compact_grid_is_bit_equal_to_the_request_grid(
+    layout: str, cache_dtype: torch.dtype
+) -> None:
+    rows_per_request, offset, count = _window(layout)
+    config = CONFIGS[cache_dtype]
+    batch = _make_batch(rows_per_request, cache_dtype, seed=len(layout))
+    stock = _launch(batch, offset, count, config, compact=False)
+    compact = _launch(batch, offset, count, config, compact=True)
+    assert torch.equal(compact, stock)
+    # The reference must have written something, or the comparison is empty.
+    assert bool((stock != SENTINEL).any())
+    assert bool((stock != 0).any())

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project

+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.nvidia.ops import qsa_indexer as qsa_indexer_ops
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import HAS_TRITON
+
+requires_qsa_kernels = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda() or not HAS_TRITON,
+    reason="QSA kernels require CUDA and Triton",
+)
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+PAGE_SIZE = 16
+PAGES = 6
+HEADS = 4
+HEAD_DIM = 32
+
+
+@requires_qsa_kernels
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cache_dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "rows_per_request",
+    [(200,), (96,) * 4, (130, 3, 0, 70), (300,) + (1, 2, 3, 4) * 25],
+    ids=["one_request", "equal_chunks", "uneven", "mixed_step"],
+)
+def test_qsa_prefill_sm120_config_is_bit_equal_to_the_default_config(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    cache_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    rows_per_request: tuple[int, ...],
+) -> None:
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(len(rows_per_request))
+    requests, total = len(rows_per_request), sum(rows_per_request)
+    q = torch.randn((total, HEADS, HEAD_DIM), generator=generator)
+    cache = torch.randn((requests * PAGES, PAGE_SIZE, 1, HEAD_DIM), generator=generator)
+    table = torch.randperm(requests * PAGES, generator=generator).view(requests, PAGES)
+    starts = torch.tensor([0, *rows_per_request]).cumsum(0) + 3
+    visible = torch.randint(
+        1, PAGES * PAGE_SIZE + 1, (total,), generator=generator, dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    args = (
+        q.to(cache_dtype).to(DEVICE),
+        cache.to(cache_dtype).to(DEVICE),
+        table.to(torch.int32).to(DEVICE),
+        starts.to(torch.int32).to(DEVICE),
+        visible.to(DEVICE),
+    )
+    width = PAGES * PAGE_SIZE
+
+    def run(is_sm120: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qsa_indexer_ops, "_is_sm120", lambda: is_sm120)
+        workspace = torch.full((total * width,), -1.0, device=DEVICE)
+        logits = qsa_indexer_ops._prefill_logits(
+            *args, workspace, max(rows_per_request), width, 0, total
+        )
+        return logits.clone()
+
+    assert (
+        qsa_indexer_ops._SM120_PREFILL_CONFIG[cache_dtype]
+        != qsa_indexer_ops._PREFILL_CONFIG[cache_dtype]
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(run(True), run(False))
+    assert bool((run(False) != -1.0).any())
